draft_en.subject: A house-brand PoE position alongside HiLook - IntelLink or Panacom label from small lots
draft_en.body:
Hi Marcus,

Over the past months you had a steady stream of product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 22 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Alongside the HiLook PoE switches you wholesale, a house-brand position under IntelLink or Panacom from small lots, at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD; 24 x Gigabit PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP, L2+ managed - STC-424DGGPM-280W - $134.5; budget unmanaged 8 x PoE+ + 2 x Gigabit - STC-028GP - $25.1. Logo on the unit is free; colour box from 200 sets. RCM stays on your side.

One question: is there a house-brand PoE position your installer customers ask for that HiLook does not fill?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
